mapper.sql: id, public_no, chain, tx_hash, log_index, block_number, block_hash, user_id, amount, status, confirmations, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT last_block FROM wallet_chain_cursor WHERE chain = #{chain}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wallet_chain_cursor (chain, last_block) VALUES (#{chain}, #{block}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_block = VALUES(last_block)

INSERT IGNORE INTO wallet_deposit (public_no, chain, tx_hash, log_index, block_number, block_hash, from_address, to_address, user_id, amount, status) VALUES (#{publicNo}, #{chain}, #{txHash}, #{logIndex}, #{blockNumber}, #{blockHash}, #{from}, #{to}, #{userId}, #{amount}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM wallet_deposit WHERE chain = #{chain} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE wallet_deposit SET confirmations = #{confirmations} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE wallet_deposit SET status = #{status}, confirmations = #{confirmations}, credited_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'CREDITED' THEN UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) ELSE NULL END WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM wallet_deposit WHERE chain = #{chain} AND status = 'CREDITED' AND block_number >= #{minBlock} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE wallet_deposit SET status = 'REVERSED' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'CREDITED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wallet_suspense (user_id, deposit_id, amount, note) VALUES (#{userId}, #{depositId}, #{amount}, #{note})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM wallet_deposit WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
